name: persona-desktop
description: Assistente de IA discreto para reuniões no Windows.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on dist-electron/main.js tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win portable --publish never --config.electronDist=./node_modules/electron/dist
